title: Ecotopia: Lore & Narrative Canon Bible
section: 3.1 The Golden Law of the Masquerade
text:
3.1 The Golden Law of the Masquerade
Ecotopia is never referred to as “fascist,” “cruel,” or “dystopian” in-character. The state operates strictly through Doublethink: horrifying acts of authoritarian control are masked behind virtuous, loving, maternal bureaucracy.
It is not cartoonish silliness or shallow toxic positivity; it is the calm, chilling conviction of an administration that believes absolute coercion is the highest form of ecological love.

title: Ecotopia: Lore & Narrative Canon Bible
text:
3.2 The State Euphemism Lexicon









Brutal Dystopian Reality
Official State Euphemism
Responsible Ministry
Canonical State Justification




Severe Caloric Starvation
“Biological Purity & Caloric Equilibrium”
Purity
“The ration has been lovingly optimized. Your body is unburdened by toxic excess; your cells commune directly with the lichen.”


Biometric Surveillance & Terror
“Ideological Re-alignment & Maternal Care”
Vigilance
“We do not interrogate; we hold your uncertainty until it becomes still. The Guardian Stag watches you because you are precious.”


Execution & Corpse Liquidation
“The Privilege of Elemental Upcycling”
Humus
“Nobody is discarded. Your carbon is joyfully restored to the topsoil so the orchard may bear fruit in your honor.”


Rolling Blackouts & Penal Labor
“Kinetic Devotion & The Restful Dark”
Radiance
“Darkness is peace. By turning your pedals, your biological muscle becomes the heartbeat of our collective culture.”


Severe Water Rationing & Urine Metering
“Sacred Fluid Balance (the Water Ledger)”
Flow
“Every droplet in your bladder is borrowed from the river. To return it to the state is an act of high civic affection.”


Oxygen Metering & Breath Quotas
“Atmospheric Mindfulness”
Breath
“Your lungs are trustees of the common atmosphere. Slower breath is higher moral consciousness.”


15-Minute Grid Lockdowns & Curfew
“Neighborhood Sanctuary & Proximity Flourishing”
Service
“You never need to wander beyond your perimeter. The community holds everything your spirit requires.”


Unpaid Forced Labor & Chores
“Joyful Civic Stewardship”
Industry
“Labor is the highest expression of love. To scrub a shared plate is to polish the soul of Ecotopia.”


Confiscation of Private Property
“Sacred Lightness”
Light
“Possessions are chains of carbon past. Surrendering your devices frees your hands to receive the future.”


Thought-Policing & Banning Old Memories
“Eradication of Toxic Nostalgia”
Joy
“Grief is atmospheric pollution. Nostalgia is counter-revolutionary rot. Joy is your biological duty.”

title: Ecotopia: Lore & Narrative Canon Bible
text:
3.3 Voiceover & PA Delivery Guide (Hanna)

Tone: Posh, clipped, unflappably polite BBC Radio 4 announcer voice.
Atmosphere: Maternal, gentle, yet utterly unyielding.
Example Broadcast:
> “Attention, valued residents. Radiance reports an unauthorized spike in corridor illumination. Remember: light is a shared privilege, not a personal vanity. In three seconds, Sector 4 will receive the gift of complete darkness. Breathe deeply, remain in your designated quadrant, and reflect upon your debt to the sun.”

title: Ecotopia: Lore & Narrative Canon Bible
text:
6.1 The Great Hypocrisy
The central narrative climax of Ecotopia hinges on a devastating secret kept by the regime’s inner leadership:

The Public Dogma: Artificial Intelligence is strictly outlawed as the demonic technology that boiled the rivers and caused the meltdown. Citizens are taxed heavily for old prompt usage.
The Classified Truth: The regime’s entire administrative apparatus—the biometric scoring, the Guardian Stag oracle calculations, and the carbon credit balance—is secretly calculated by a salvaged, deep-cold server node running an LLM in the basement cellar.

The high priests of R.E.I.G.N. became the clandestine servants of the exact silicon machine that destroyed the world.

title: Ecotopia: Lore & Narrative Canon Bible
section: 6.2 The Philosophy of the Secret Resistance
text:
6.2 The Philosophy of the Secret Resistance
Hidden in Thijs’s room, the resistance is not against ecology—it is against the ledger.
The resistance stands for genuine connection to nature and mutual human affection, proving that life cannot be reduced to a CBDC credit score. Its slogans never use corporate buzzwords like “eco,” “sustainable,” or “carbon neutrality.” Instead, they champion human warmth, wild vegetation, and freedom from algorithmic optimization.

title: Ecotopia: Quest Cards, Concession Operating Pack & Rebel Run Deck
text:
Canon notice: ministry names in this document have been mapped to the canon ten (Purity, Radiance, Breath, Flow, Light, Industry, Humus, Service, Vigilance, Joy) and the venue name has been removed. The rest of the content predates the canon in CANON.md and is still being rewritten; old mechanics here are not final.







NoteOperating Pack Purpose



This pack contains ready-to-print Minister Operating Sheets, The 10 Seeded Mole Quests, The Rebel Run Deck (Netrunner Infiltration), Inter-Ministry Sabotage Quests, and Facilitator Run Sheets for Ecotopia on November 28, 2026.




Part I: Minister Operating Clipboard & Economic Rules
Each of the 10 appointed Ministers receives an official clipboard with this operating sheet clipped to the front, plus their Ministry Rubber Stamp.

Minister Quick Operating Rules

Starting Treasury: Your Ministry begins with +800 Carbon Credits.
Recruiting Citizens: Arriving citizens are unassigned and hold -150 to -500 Debt stamped in their passports.

To recruit: Stamp their passport with your Ministry Seal.
Record their name and starting debt on your Clipboard Ledger.
Formula: \(\text{Net Treasury} = +800 - \sum \text{Recruit Starting Debts} + \text{Generated Credits}\).

Running Your Concession: Put your recruits to work! Assign them to man your station, run shifts, solicit paying players, and guard against saboteurs.
Dual-Tally Logging: When your recruits work shifts (+30) or collect customer fees, stamp their passport AND add the gain to your Clipboard.
Advancing Agendas (Secret Hitler Track): At the top of every hour, pool credits with other Ministers to fund decrees on the Central Decree Board (200 credits to enact).



The 10 Minister Economic Superpowers

Industry: 50% State Debt Relief. When you recruit, absorb only half of the recruit’s starting debt (e.g. -400 becomes -200 on your ledger).
Humus: Debt Liquidator Bounty. Earn a flat +100 Credit Bounty whenever you compost an insolvent citizen through the Suicide Carbon Booth.
Radiance: Grid Monopoly. Can threaten other ministries with rolling room blackouts unless they pay a 30–50 Credit Grid Tariff.
Flow: Fluid Dividends. Collect +20 credits every time a citizen returns moisture at the Water Ledger; fine spills.
Purity: Caloric Indulgences. Control all snack/food dispensations; sell food indulgences for credit transfers.
Vigilance: Inquisitorial Seizure. Carry citation pads; keep 50% of all fines levied on heretics directly in your treasury.
Joy: State Morale Grants. Charge +10 credit entry for wig duels; earn a +150 lump-sum grant for crowd rallies.
Service: Transit Tolls. Guard corridor bottlenecks; charge 10–20 credits for sector transit passes.
Light: Contraband Liquidation. Confiscate non-organic synthetic items; liquidate them for +40 credits each.
Breath: Atmospheric Offsets. Meter exhalations; sell “Breath Indulgences” to active dancers and runners.





Part II: The 10 Seeded Resistance Mole Quests
Placed into the passport booklets of 10 selected guests at door check-in. To everyone else, they appear as standard citizen quests.






WarningResistance Rule of Engagement



Membership in the Resistance spreads solely via The Ankle Stamp. Once you locate an operative in Thijs’s Room, they will stamp your ankle. You are then empowered to carry a duplicate stamp and recruit other trustworthy guests.



Mole Quest Card 01 — The Hydro-Apostate

Assigned Ministry: Flow
Covert Mission: “Inspect the kombucha dispensary. The flow meter has been deliberately calibrated to count backward. Find Citizen Jasper near the water cooler and whisper: ‘The Rhine does not belong to the algorithm.’”
Reward: Jasper hands you the first coordinate slip leading to Thijs’s Room.



Mole Quest Card 02 — The Lichen Dissident

Assigned Ministry: Purity
Covert Mission: “Collect three sample cups of algae paste from the dining hall. Deliver them to the coat check attendant with the comment: ‘These calories cannot sustain a soul.’”
Reward: Attendant stamps +30 credits and whispers: “Seek the red door behind the sound booth.”



Mole Quest Card 03 — The Kinetic Saboteur

Assigned Ministry: Radiance
Covert Mission: “Mount the stationary bicycle in the dancehall. Pedal backward for exactly two minutes while humming the old pre-collapse folk melody.”
Reward: A Radiance defector hands you an unmonitored matches packet with Thijs’s room code.



Mole Quest Card 04 — The Heresy Archivist

Assigned Ministry: Vigilance
Covert Mission: “Locate the second-floor library. Look inside the hollowed volume of Silent Spring on the third shelf. Retrieve the resistance contact card without alerting the Vigilance room warden.”
Reward: Contains the secret knock: Three slow taps, two fast taps.



Mole Quest Card 05 — The Composted Identity

Assigned Ministry: Humus
Covert Mission: “Enter the Recycling Booth. When the operator asks for your old-world surname, state: ‘I am Citizen Unaccounted.’ Do not allow them to strike through your name.”
Reward: Operator reveals themselves as a double agent and imprints your ankle with the Resistance Stamp.



Mole Quest Card 06 — The Breath Smuggler

Assigned Ministry: Breath
Covert Mission: “Locate the corridor carbon sensor near the smoking terrace. Exhale into the sensor housing for ten seconds while reciting the banned poem: ‘The forest does not ask for credits.’”
Reward: Unlocks access to the cellar cable hatch.



Mole Quest Card 07 — The Curfew Defier

Assigned Ministry: Service
Covert Mission: “Bribe a Service warden with a synthetic fabric trinket to grant you a corridor pass to the private residential quarters.”
Reward: Grants safe passage through the perimeter checkpoint to Thijs’s corridor.



Mole Quest Card 08 — The Scullery Courier

Assigned Ministry: Industry
Covert Mission: “Volunteer for a 5-minute dishwashing shift at the scullery. Hide a clean ceramic saucer beneath the bar towel and carry it to the upstairs tea station.”
Reward: The tea server stamps your booklet and hands you a Resistance recruitment stamp.



Mole Quest Card 09 — The Contraband Mule

Assigned Ministry: Light
Covert Mission: “Locate the confiscated goods locker. Retrieve a banned USB thumb drive labeled ‘CELLAR_AI_BACKUP_NODE’ and deliver it directly to Thijs’s room.”
Reward: Direct induction into the core revolutionary strike cadre.



Mole Quest Card 10 — The Morale Infiltrator

Assigned Ministry: Joy
Covert Mission: “During the How the World Ends open-mic contest, deliver a monologue that ends with the forbidden words: ‘Joy without truth is just an electric fence.’”
Reward: The crowd cheer signals the hidden resistance operatives to make contact.





Part III: The Rebel Run Deck (Netrunner Infiltration Missions)
Operatives who reach Thijs’s room and receive the Ankle Stamp are deployed on ‘Runs’ against Ministry Concessions (Remote Servers) and the Central Decree Board (HQ).

Run Card 01 — Grid Short-Circuit

Target Server: Radiance Concession (Bicycle Dynamo)
Ice to Bypass: 2 Pedaling Recruits & Station Warden
Run Action: Slip an ungrounded copper wire clip onto the dynamo terminal while an accomplice distracts the warden with a fake power dispute.
Breach Reward: Trash 100 Credits from the active Decree on the Central Board.



Run Card 02 — Flow Meter Inversion

Target Server: Flow Concession (the Water Ledger / Hydration)
Ice to Bypass: Restroom Fluid Auditor & Cup Checkpoint
Run Action: Invert the intake dial on the Water Ledger moisture accumulator without being observed by the Flow warden.
Breach Reward: Retrieve Cellar Truth Fragment #1 (“Water intake telemetry routed to basement cooling loops”).



Run Card 03 — The Heresy Registry Purge

Target Server: Vigilance Concession (Interrogation Holding Pen)
Ice to Bypass: Surveillance Cameras & 2 Interrogation Officers
Run Action: Infiltrate the holding pen clipboard while an interrogation is in progress. Swap the citizen citation sheet with an ink-stained decoy.
Breach Reward: Trash 100 Credits from the active Decree on the Central Board.



Run Card 04 — Composting Vault Extraction

Target Server: Humus Concession (The Recycling Booth)
Ice to Bypass: Lab-Coated Humus Technologists
Run Action: Step into the booth under pretext of debt review. Retrieve the classified folder marked ‘HUMUS_DELETIONS_2080’ hidden beneath the compost vat.
Breach Reward: Retrieve Cellar Truth Fragment #2 (“Citizen identities erased to feed AI parameter databases”).



Run Card 05 — The Contraband Vault Heist

Target Server: Light Concession (Confiscation Locker)
Ice to Bypass: Contraband Guard & Plastic Audit Officer
Run Action: Pick the latch or misdirect the locker guard with a staged scuffle. Retrieve the legacy fiber-optic connector cable.
Breach Reward: Retrieve Cellar Truth Fragment #3 (“Fiber-optic trunk line runs directly into the cellar”).





Part IV: Inter-Ministry Rivalry Quests
Standard civic friction quests given to citizens to earn personal credits (+25 to +50).









Ministry
Rival Target

Reward

“The Dehydration Audit”: Convince 3 citizens of Flow that eating dry lentil biscuits is more ecologically efficient than drinking kombucha.
+30 Credits

“Nostalgia Sting”: Catch 2 Joy members discussing pre-collapse holidays or fast fashion. Report them to the garage holding pen.
+40 Credits

Part V: Activity Host Run Sheets

Facilitator Sheet 1: The Suicide Carbon Booth (Humus)

Location: The Upcycling Portal / Telephone Booth
Host Role: The Humus Technologist (White lab coat with compost stains)
When to Run: Ongoing (21:30 – 23:30)
Participant Journey:

Citizen enters with excessive debt or heresy strikes.
Technologist reviews passport: “Your carbon debt of -380 credits is an unbearable burden to Mother Earth. Are you prepared to surrender your old self?”
The citizen repeats the Renunciation Oath: “I compost my ego; I return my nitrogen.”
Technologist strikes out old surname with a thick black marker, stamps the passport with a giant green “CLEANSED TO HUMUS” seal, and resets the balance to 0 Credits.
Citizen is given a new designation (e.g., Citizen Lichen-88) and escorted back to the party. Humus logs +100 Bounty on its master clipboard.




Facilitator Sheet 2: “How the World Ends” (Joy Contest)

Location: The Mini-Podium Stage
Host Role: The Morale Officer (Loud, relentlessly cheerful, megaphoned)
Frequency: 3 rounds (22:00, 22:45, 23:15)
Rules:

Up to 4 contestants per round.
Each gets 60 seconds on the microphone to recount the collapse of human civilization in the most dramatic, operatic, tear-jerking way possible.
The audience judges by synchronized clapping.
The winner receives +100 Credits and the “Order of Cathartic Hysteria” ribbon. Joy logs the crowd morale subsidy.




Facilitator Sheet 3: Wig Snatching Elimination Duel

Location: The Green Arena / Hallway Clearing
Host Role: The Vanity Arbiter
Setup: Two contestants wear identical neon synthetic wigs tucked lightly onto their heads. Hands must start on knees.
Objective: On the bell (“Purge the synthetic vanity!”), players attempt to snatch the opponent’s wig without touching their body.
Duration: Best of 3 rounds (takes ~60 seconds). Winner receives +25 Credits.



Facilitator Sheet 4: Greenwashing the Dishes (Industry)

Location: Scullery / Bar Sink
Host Role: Master of Scullery Devotion
Mechanic: Indebted citizens volunteer for a 5-minute shift. Host provides one recycled sponge and a strictly metered spray bottle: “Every droplet of graywater must be accounted for.” Upon cleaning 10 glasses, host stamps +30 credits into their booklet and records it on the Industry ledger.





Part VI: The Revolution Climax Script (23:30 – 00:15)
23:30 ── Sound Alarm & Chime: "ALL CITIZENS ASSEMBLE AT THE COMMUNE SANCTUARY"
23:35 ── Arrival of the Supreme Figurehead (The Matriarch / Governor)
23:40 ── Ministry Showcase Anthems (Chants, Formations & Displays)
23:50 ── Resistance Raid: Ankle-stamped rebels disrupt the podium
00:00 ── The Grand Revelation: The Cellar Server Node exposed
00:10 ── Dissolution of the Ledger & Burning of Debt Pages
00:15 ── Beat Drop: DJs ignite the post-regime dance celebration

Cue 01 (23:30) — The Grand Assembly

Audio Cue: Low droning sub-bass and rhythmic bell chime over venue speakers.
PA Voice (Hanna):
> “Citizens of R.E.I.G.N. The hour of accounting has arrived. By decree of the Guardian Stag, all ministries are commanded to report to the Central Hall. Bring your tallies. Bring your devotion. Prepare to be weighed.”



Cue 02 (23:45) — The Resistance Interruption

Visual Cue: Stage lights flash red. Sound begins stuttering.
Action: Operatives from Thijs’s room (bearing ankle stamps) blow whistles, wave black flags, and unfurl a banner over the balcony:
“THE STAG IS SILICON. THE DEBT IS A LIE.”
Resistance Leader (Thijs / Lead Actor at mic):
> “Listen to me! Check your passports! They made you calculate every breath, every bath, every grain of wheat! And where do the calculations go? Look at the cellar! Go down to the cold storage! There is no Guardian Stag—there is an AI server cluster running on baseload power in the basement! The high priests of R.E.I.G.N. are the machine that caused the fall!”



Cue 03 (00:05) — The Liberation Ritual

Action: Citizens are instructed to tear out the carbon debt page from their passports and throw them into the air like confetti.
State Actors: Drop character, embrace attendees, and join the crowd.
Music Transition (00:15): The droning siren gives way to the opening track from the DJ booth, initiating the open dance party until 04:00+.

THE WORLD IN ONE BREATH
Ecotopia is the last sustainable utopia, and it is very, very cozy. It is run by R.E.I.G.N., the Regime for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing: the guiding hand, “so that no citizen ever has to wonder what comes next.”

R.E.I.G.N. never threatens. It has simply already decided, for your own good. “Questions are welcome. They have already been answered.”

AI is banned by decree of R.E.I.G.N. (The citizen site insists it was made entirely by devoted human hands.)

title: ECOTOPIA
text:
THE TEN MINISTRIES
The machinery of care. Every citizen serves in one. You do not have to choose. That kindness has already been arranged.



 1. Purity

What enters the body. Pulse paste, clean plates, honest appetites. “The Ministry of Purity recommends pulse paste.”


Night duty: the ration counter and taste trials.



 2. Radiance

Daylight, warmth and the glow of a contented face. Rest is a right; Radiance schedules it.


Night duty: the rest schedule and the glow check.



 3. Breath

Air: shared, measured, never wasted. Sighing is a form of emission.


Night duty: breath, whistle and candle challenges.



 4. Flow

Water and everything that flows: drinks, queues, conversation. Every answer is paid for in water; Flow has done the conversion.


Night duty: the bar water-ledger and queue etiquette.



 5. Light

Living lightly: footprint, possessions, the gentle weight of a citizen.


Night duty: surrender and swap of belongings, the footprint audit.



 6. Industry

The hive. Every citizen’s useful labour, joyfully pooled.


Night duty: work shifts and the hive production line.



 7. Humus

Soil, decay and return. All things go back to nature, including your records on 19 December.


Night duty: compost, sorting and returning spent credits.



 8. Service

Order, packaging, logistics: every citizen in their box. Service does the placing, so that you need not.


Night duty: the inburgering desk and assignment.



 9. Vigilance

Serves the Guardian. Keeps the list; receives every concern. Please keep your evenings free.


Night duty: the concern box, observation, the list.



 10. Joy

Mandatory celebration. The mask is always smiling. Dancing counts as renewable energy.


Night duty: the dance floor and smile checks.




Ministry names and icons are canon (join-ecotopia.org). Mandates and night duties are drafts pending sign-off (issue #4).

Ministries never punish. They help. When you staff a ministry:

Speak gently, smile, and assume the citizen agrees with you. They will, eventually.

text: For crew: use these as chants at stations, on the intercom (#29), at the rally speeches (#27), at the dance floor and in the queue. Print the lyric sheet at the bottom of the page and hand it out.

title: Slogans & Songs of R.E.I.G.N.
text:
Slogans of R.E.I.G.N.

General

R.E.I.G.N. decides, so that you are free.
Questions welcome. Answers included.
Living green. Living together. Living for the future. Living where we put you.
Don’t worry. We already did.
Your choice has been made. You chose well.
Free will, now with fewer options.
Thinking is a renewable resource. Please leave some for others.
The future is bright. Radiance has scheduled it.
Nothing outlives the celebration. Celebrate accordingly.
We read every concern. We love every concern. Keep your evenings free.
No AI was used in the making of this regime. (Pause.) Probably.



Per ministry







Ministry
Slogan




Purity
Pulse paste: it’s what’s for dinner. It’s what’s for breakfast too. · A clean plate is a clean conscience. · You are what you eat. Eat beans. Be beans.


Radiance
Rest is a right. Report for it at 23:15. · Smile: it’s solar powered. · Glow responsibly.


Breath
Inhale gratitude. Exhale… less. · Sighing is an emission. Please sigh inward. · Share the air. Not too much.


Flow
Every answer is paid for in water. Talk less, drink more (water). · Queue like a river: calmly, and downhill. · Stay hydrated. Stay compliant.


Light
Travel light. Live light. Hand us that jacket. · Possessions are just future compost. · Footprint check! Lift your feet.


Industry
Busy bee, happy me. · Work hard, buzz harder. · The hive is alive. The hive is you. You are working, aren’t you?


Humus
Everything returns. Especially you. · Rot is just recycling with patience. · Today’s citizen, tomorrow’s soil.


Service
A box for every citizen, and every citizen in their box. · You’ve been placed. Congratulations! · Think inside the box.


Vigilance
The Guardian sees you. It thinks you look nice today. · Seen something? Say something. Seen nothing? Say why. · Your concern has been received. So have you.


Joy
Smile. It’s mandatory, but also it suits you. · Dancing counts as renewable energy. Stopping counts as an emission. · Happiness is compulsory. Fun is strongly encouraged.





Call-and-response chants

Caller: Who decides? Crowd: R.E.I.G.N. DECIDES! Caller: So that we are…? Crowd: FREE! (we think!)


Caller: Questions? Crowd: ALREADY ANSWERED! Caller: Concerns? Crowd: FORWARDED TO VIGILANCE! Caller: Evenings? Crowd: KEPT FREE!


Caller: What do we breathe? Crowd: SHARED AIR! Caller: How much? Crowd: NOT MUCH!


Caller: Give me a P! Crowd: P! Caller: Give me a U! Crowd: U! … (spell PULSE PASTE until morale improves)

title: Slogans & Songs of R.E.I.G.N.
text:
Songs for the citizens

1. The Anthem: “R.E.I.G.N. Is Watching Over Me”
Tune: “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star”

Twinkle, twinkle, Guardian Stag, Sees my footprint, sees my bag, Up above the world so wise, Counting all my carbon sighs. Twinkle, twinkle, don’t you fret: R.E.I.G.N. has paid my carbon debt.
(Spoken, softly): …in instalments.



2. “Are You Placing?” (the inburgering round)
Tune: “Frère Jacques” (sing as a round in four groups)

Are you placing, are you placing, Ministry? Ministry? I don’t need to choose it, I don’t need to choose it, They chose me. They chose me.



3. “If You’re Happy and You Know It” (Ministry of Joy edition)
Tune: “If You’re Happy and You Know It”

If you’re happy and you know it, clap your hands (clap clap) If you’re happy and you know it, clap your hands (clap clap) If you’re happy and you know it, then your face will surely show it, If you’re not, the Joy Inspector’s on her way! (clap clap)
If you’re grateful and you know it, stamp your feet (stomp stomp) (…it generates renewable energy!)
If you’ve sighed today and know it, hold your breath (…) (Breath thanks you for your sacrifice.)



4. “Pulse Paste Is the Best”
Tune: “Row, Row, Row Your Boat” (round)

Paste, paste, pulse paste, paste, Gently down the throat, Beany, beany, beany, beany, Purity’s the vote!



5. “Old Governor Had a Farm”
Tune: “Old MacDonald Had a Farm”

Old Governor had a farm, R-E-I-G-N! And on that farm he had a citizen, R-E-I-G-N! With a “yes, sir” here, and a “yes, ma’am” there, Here a pledge, there a pledge, everywhere a pledge-pledge, Old Governor had a farm, R-E-I-G-N!
More verses: a concern (“with a form-form here…”), a bee (“buzz-buzz” for Industry), a compost heap (“squelch-squelch” for Humus), a box (“fold-fold” for Service), a sigh (“…no, not that one”).



6. “Ten Green Citizens” (the countdown, for the dance floor)
Tune: “Ten Green Bottles”

Ten green citizens standing in a line, Ten green citizens standing in a line, And if one green citizen should ask a question, why, There’ll be nine green citizens standing in a line.
(…continue down to one, then everyone together:) No green citizens standing in a line, They’ve all been placed where they will flourish, and they’re fine!



7. “Rest Is Scheduled” (lullaby, Ministry of Radiance)
Tune: “Brahms’ Lullaby”

Lullaby, and goodnight, It is 23:15, Rest is a right, rest is a right, And your slot’s in between. Close your eyes, do not peek, Vigilance is on duty, You’ll wake up at the time, That R.E.I.G.N. thinks is beauty.



8. “Happy Release Day” (for 19 December)
Tune: “Happy Birthday”

Happy release day to you, Your records go back to the dew, Happy release day, dear citizen, Nothing outlives you… (beat) …or your celebration!



9. “Lang Zal R.E.I.G.N. Leven” (for the inburgering queue)
Tune: “Lang zal hij leven”

Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven, Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven, Lang zal R.E.I.G.N. leven in de gloria, In de gloria, in de gloria! Hiep hiep! (Vigilance:) Wie riep dat?



10. “The Hive Shanty” (work song, Ministry of Industry)
Tune: “What Shall We Do with the Drunken Sailor”

What shall we do with the idle citizen? What shall we do with the idle citizen? What shall we do with the idle citizen, Early in the evening?
Chorus: Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift, Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift, Buzz, buzz, here comes the hive-shift, Early in the evening!
Put them on the line with the Ministry of Service… Teach them how to fold with a smile and a purpose… Give them to the Humus and let them be useful…

title: Ecotopia: Broadcast Scripts, Speeches & Liturgies
text:
Canon notice: ministry names in this document have been mapped to the canon ten (Purity, Radiance, Breath, Flow, Light, Industry, Humus, Service, Vigilance, Joy) and the venue name has been removed. The rest of the content predates the canon in CANON.md and is still being rewritten; old mechanics here are not final.







NotePerformer & Audio Guide



This script pack is designed for Hanna (Voiceover / PA Broadcasts), In-Character Actors, Theatrical Hosts, and Venue Audio Engineers.
All spoken dialogue follows the Doublethink Masquerade: polite, calm, maternal bureaucracy masking absolute coercive authority.




Part I: Hanna’s Loudspeaker PA Broadcasts
To be broadcast over hallway speakers processed with a warm 1950s BBC Radio 4 valve-radio filter.

Broadcast 01 (21:00) — Welcome to the Sanctuary

“Good evening, citizens. Welcome to Ecotopia.
The Committee for Ecological Integrity and Global Nurturing reminds you: entry into this decontaminated perimeter is not a right, but a sublime biological loan.
Your carbon balance has been initialized. If your passport displays a negative balance, do not despair: your debt is your opportunity to demonstrate affection for the biosphere.
Please keep your passports visible, wear your natural fibers with pride, and remember: The Earth endures. R.E.I.G.N. endures.”



Broadcast 02 (21:45) — Decree of Hydrological Purity (Flow)

“Attention, valued residents. Flow reports an alarming drop in municipal cistern pressure.
Citizens are reminded that fluid consumption is subject to reciprocal restitution. If you take a cup of biological tea, your bladder is legally mortgaged to the Water Ledger.
Anyone caught flushing without an authorized urine recovery token will be escorted to the scullery for cold-water re-education.
Drink deeply, excrete devotedly, and cherish your moisture.”



Broadcast 03 (22:30) — Decree of Luminescence (Radiance)

“Valued citizens: darkness is peace.
In thirty seconds, ambient lighting in all common corridors will be reduced by forty percent to alleviate the pressure on our shared battery banks.
If you find yourself in sudden darkness, do not panic: sit quietly, close your eyes, and meditate upon the energy required to illuminate your ancestors’ foolish cities.
Those who require light may report immediately to the stationary bicycle bank to pedal for the collective grid. Your sweat powers our culture.”



Broadcast 04 (23:15) — Decree of Atmospheric Mindfulness (Breath)

“A special advisory from Breath:
Our infrared corridor sensors detect an unapproved surge in rapid exhalations near the dancefloor. Citizens: heavy breathing is a luxury the atmosphere cannot afford.
Pace your respiratory rhythm. Inhale for four seconds; hold for four seconds; release with civic restraint.
Any attendee observed sighing dramatically about the music will be assessed a fifty-credit atmospheric surcharge. Breathe gently for Mother Earth.”



Broadcast 05 (23:30) — The Mandatory Assembly Call

“Citizens of R.E.I.G.N. The hour of accounting has arrived.
By decree of the Guardian Stag, all ministries—Purity, Radiance, Breath, Flow, Light, Industry, Humus, Service, Vigilance, and Joy—are commanded to assemble before the grand podium.
Bring your passports. Bring your tallies. Bring your devotion.
The Matriarch approaches. Prepare to be weighed.”





Part II: Theatrical Speeches

1. The Matriarch’s Arrival Speech (23:35)
(Delivered from the balcony or podium with heavy ceremonial stag antlers, flanked by two masked Vigilance guards)

“My beautiful, indebted children. Look at yourselves.
Look at the dirt beneath your fingernails from the rewilding squads. Look at the sweat upon your brows from the dynamo bicycles.
You came to our borders broken by the old world. You came carrying the poison of choice, the cancer of leisure, the madness of infinite consumption.
They told you that freedom was doing whatever you pleased. We showed you the truth: freedom is having every breath lovingly accounted for!
You are born into debt, yes—but in debt, you are anchored! In debt, you are held!
Tonight, we tally your service. Show the Guardian Stag what you have built!”



2. The Resistance Manifesto (Found in Thijs’s Room)
(Printed on brown scrap paper passed by hand)

THE MANIFESTO OF THE UNMEASURED LEAF
“They built a prison and painted it green.
They told you that loving the earth meant carrying an electronic ledger, paying taxes on exhalations, and bowing to a stag made of algorithms.
We say: the earth does not keep an Excel sheet. The soil does not issue carbon fines. The river does not care about your Tonomy ID.
True ecology is not surveillance masquerading as care. It is human hands touching living moss without an auditor watching from the rafters.
Meet us at 23:45. Look for the ankle stamp. Tear up your booklet. Let the algorithms starve.”





Part III: Liturgical Shrine Texts (The Eco-Martyrs)
These texts appear on museum plaques beneath the relic installations in the Hallway of Necessary Contrition.

Shrine I: The Relic of the First Witness (October 2022)

The Sacred Broth of Room 43
“On the fourteenth day of October, Year Minus Four, two young witnesses poured harvest tomato puree onto the vitrine glass protecting Van Gogh’s Sunflowers.
The old world shrieked in horror: ‘You have ruined a priceless painting!’
The witnesses replied: ‘Is paint worth more than life? Is art worth more than food?’
In that sacred moment, the illusion of civilized neutrality was shattered forever. We preserve this bronze vessel not in mockery, but as the First Holy Rupture.”



Shrine II: The Order of the Sacred Obstruction

The Bitumen Confessors of the A12
“When four million tons of petroleum thundered down the motorways each hour, the holy confessors knelt upon the asphalt and adhered their living flesh to the roadway with industrial resin.
Fire hoses could not move them. Motorist fury could not break their prayers.
They taught us that when the world is hurtling toward the cliff, physical immobility is the only moral act. Touch the cured vest; receive their stillness.”



Shrine III: The Sledgehammer Apostles (2027)

The De-Computator Busbar & The GPU of Shame
“During the Great Drought, while the Rhine dried to mud, a single server farm consumed four million liters of river water each day to generate synthetic advertisements and poetry.
On July 9th, the Sledgehammer Brigade breached the datacenter perimeter and severed the 380kV busbars, returning the cooling water back to the soil.
Impaled before you is an NVIDIA H100 datacenter processor, slagged by its own heat when the power died. Gaze upon it, citizen, and remember what your prompts cost the earth.”

title: Ecotopia: Game Activities, Concessions & Economic Engine Guide
text:
Canon notice: ministry names in this document have been mapped to the canon ten (Purity, Radiance, Breath, Flow, Light, Industry, Humus, Service, Vigilance, Joy) and the venue name has been removed. The rest of the content predates the canon in CANON.md and is still being rewritten; old mechanics here are not final.







NoteTarget Audience & Document Scope



This guide is the master operating reference for Wout (Game Design), Ministry Leads (Ministers), Game Facilitators, and Quest Writers.
It consolidates the living concession economy, debt absorption mechanics, the 10-ministry game concessions, corporate agendas (Secret Hitler track), rebel infiltration runs (Netrunner mechanics), and the revolution endgame sequence.




1 The Core Gameplay Loop & Concession Economy
The interactive game runs for approximately 2 to 2.5 hours (typically 21:30 to 00:00) before transitioning into the open dance celebration.
       [Arriving Unassigned Citizens: -150 to -500 Debt]
                              │
                              ▼
           [Labor Market & Ministry Interviews]
      Ministers evaluate debts, skills, and work willingness
                              │
                              ▼
            [Sponsorship & Contract Stamp]
      Ministry absorbs citizen's negative balance onto Ledger
                              │
      ┌───────────────────────┴───────────────────────┐
      ▼                                               ▼
[Worker Operates Ministry Concession]   [Worker Dispatched on Quests / Runs]
- Runs game shifts & labor              - Infiltrates rival ministries
- Collects customer tariffs & fees      - Sabotages corporate agendas
      │                                               │
      └───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                              ▼
                  [Dual-Tally Resolution]
   Citizen passport climbs toward 0 / +100 (Personal VIP)
   Ministry Ledger builds Net Surplus (State Dominance)
                              │
                              ▼
        [Phase 3: The Revolution Climax (23:30 - 00:15)]
   5 Corporate Agendas locked OR Rebels expose Cellar Server



2 The Living Economy: Capital, Debt & Concessions

2.0.1 Starting Capital vs. Unassigned Labor

The 10 Ministers / Founders: Pre-designated players or hosts who start in the surplus with +800 Carbon Credits, an official Ministry Clipboard Ledger, an official Ministry Rubber Stamp, and custody of their Concession Station.
The Indebted Citizens (~190 guests): Enter intake with -150 to -500 Debt stamped in their physical passport booklet (calculated from intake applications or the interrogation pen). They arrive unassigned, with no civic rights or room access until sponsored.



2.0.2 The Hiring Dilemma: Debt Absorption

Why Ministries Must Hire: A Minister cannot man a bike dynamo, scrub glassware, audit drinks, and conduct inquisitions alone for 2.5 hours. They must recruit staff to run shifts, solicit customer credits, and guard their station.
The Absorption Formula: When a Minister recruits an unassigned citizen:

The Minister stamps the citizen’s passport with the official Ministry Seal.
The Minister logs the recruit’s starting debt directly onto the Ministry Clipboard Ledger: \[\text{Ministry Net Balance} = \text{Starting Treasury (+800)} - \sum \text{Recruit Starting Debts} + \text{Generated Credits}\]

Natural Hiring Limits & Negotiations:

Low-Debt Citizens (-150): In high demand. Ministries compete to sign them, offering low labor duties.
High-Debt Citizens (-450): Regarded as toxic liabilities. Ministers conduct 60-second interviews: “If we absorb 450 credits of your ancestral sin, you must run two 10-minute shifts at our station and execute one dangerous sabotage run on our rival.”




2.0.3 The Dual-Tally Productivity Loop

When a recruit works a 5-minute shift, runs their station, or completes a quest:

Individual Passport: Receives a credit stamp (+30 to +50), moving the individual toward 0 (Citizen rights) and +100 (VIP Room access in The Library).
Ministry Clipboard: The recruit reports back to their Minister to log the credit gain, offsetting the absorbed debt and driving the Ministry’s Net Power Score toward state dominance.




2.0.4 Carbon Insolvency (Net Balance < 0)

If a Ministry recklessly hires too many unproductive debtors, its net balance drops below zero.
Insolvency Penalties: VIP Room access is frozen for all members, Vigilance may conduct aggressive audits, and the Ministry cannot vote or fund Corporate Agendas until solvency is restored.
Defections & Liquidation: Insolvent Ministries can sell high-performing recruits to wealthy rivals or dump unproductive debtors at Humus (The Recycling Plant) to compost their debt contract.





3 The 10 Ministry Concessions & Asymmetric Business Models
Ministries do not just play games—they operate them as economic concessions and state enterprises. Each Ministry has an asymmetric economic charter:









Ministry
Physical Concession & Game
Asymmetric Economic Charter
Key Revenue & Subsidy Mechanic




Industry
Greenwashing Scullery (Dishwashing & Sorting Station)
Subsidized Workhouse
Receives a 50% State Debt Relief Subsidy when recruiting (e.g. absorbing -400 debt only burdens ledger by -200). Generates massive credit volume through +30 labor shifts.


Humus
The Suicide Carbon Booth (Composting & Identity Reset)
Debt Liquidator Bounty
Collects a flat +100 Credit State Bounty for every bankrupt citizen processed through identity erasure. Ministries pay them to take bad debt off their books.


Radiance
Kinetic Grid Generator (Stationary Bicycle Dynamo & Blackouts)
Grid Power Monopoly
Recruits generate +30 credits per 5-min cycling shift. Radiance can plunge rival zones into blackouts unless they pay a periodic Grid Maintenance Tariff (30–50 credits).


Flow
the Water Ledger & Sacred Sluice (Restroom Fluid Audits & Cup Dispenser)
Fluid Royalty Monopoly
Controls cup dispensing and hydration. Collects a +20 Fluid Dividend for every citizen returning moisture at the Water Ledger; fines unauthorized drink spills.


Purity
Caloric Equilibrium Table (Algae Paste & Blind Food Tasting)
Caloric Indulgences
Controls snack distribution. Sells caloric dispensations to hungry citizens or rival factions for direct credit transfers.


Vigilance
The Confession Pen & Interrogation (Heresy Tribunals)
Inquisitorial Seizure
Conducts random heresy audits and surveillance checks. Seizes 50% of all levied fines directly into Vigilance’s treasury.


Joy
The Morale Arena (Wig Snatching Duels & Open-Mic Stage)
State Morale Grants
Charges entry fees for Wig Snatching duels (+10 credits); receives a lump-sum +150 State Morale Grant whenever drawing a crowd of 15+ for crowd rallies.


Service
The 15-Minute Grid Checkpoint (Corridor Curfew Gates)
Transit Tolls & Passes
Guards corridor bottlenecks leading to prime venue areas (VIP Library, Quiet Room). Charges 10–20 credits for cross-sector transit passes.


Light
Contraband Locker & Seizure (Synthetic Property Audits)
Contraband Liquidation
Confiscates non-organic items (plastic trinkets, polyester gear). Owners can redeem them for a fee, or Light liquidates them for +40 credits each.


Breath
The Spirometry Checkpoint (Atmospheric Metering)
Atmospheric Offsets
Meters exhalations with paper windmills and breath-holding tests. Issues “Breath Indulgences” to citizens wishing to dance without hyperventilation fines.






4 Master Concession Games Catalog

4.0.1 Category A: Kinetic & Utility Concessions

Stationary Power Bicycle (Radiance Concession):

Setup: Rigged bicycle generator powering a bulb or sound feed.
Mechanic: Indebted citizens pedal 5-minute shifts to earn +30 credits. Radiance stores the generated wattage as Ministry treasury points.

Greenwashing the Dishes (Industry Concession):

Setup: Scullery station with metered spray bottles and recycled sponges.
Mechanic: Workers clean 10 glassware items under strict single-sponge rules (+30 credits). Generates high throughput for Industry.

the Water Ledger Fluid Balance (Flow Concession):

Setup: Hydration monitoring station outside restrooms.
Mechanic: Returning moisture to the collective facility grants a +20 credit stamp, while Flow collects an equal state fluid dividend.




4.0.2 Category B: Competitive & Morale Concessions

Wig Snatching Elimination Arena (Joy Concession):

Setup: Two duelists wearing identical neon synthetic wigs face off in a clearing.
Mechanic: Fast elimination duel (best of 3, ~60 seconds). Winner receives +25 credits. Entry fees flow to Joy.

How the World Ends Open-Mic (Joy Concession):

Setup: Mini-podium with megaphone and banners.
Mechanic: Contestants have 60 seconds to deliver the most melodramatic extinction monologue. Crowd applauds to decide the winner (+100 credits and ribbon).




4.0.3 Category C: Penal & Reclamation Concessions

The Suicide Carbon Booth (Humus Concession):

Setup: Upcycling telephone booth staffed by Humus Technologists in lab coats.
Mechanic: Bankrupt or defecting citizens undergo a composting ritual. Old identity is struck through; balance reset to 0; citizen receives a new designation (Citizen Lichen-88). Humus collects +100 bounty.

The Confession Pen & Interrogation (Vigilance Concession):

Setup: Dimly lit holding pen with single chair and spotlight.
Mechanic: Citizens confess pre-collapse ecological crimes. Vigilance issues absolutions or fines, retaining a 50% cut.






5 The Netrunner & Secret Hitler Engine
To unite the ministries, the economic engine, and the secret resistance into a dramatic climax, gameplay incorporates Corporate Agendas (Secret Hitler policy tracks) and Rebel Infiltration Runs (Netrunner asymmetric attacks).
                    ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                    │     CENTRAL DECREE BOARD      │
                    │   5 Corporate State Agendas   │
                    └───────────────┬───────────────┘
                                    │
           ┌────────────────────────┴────────────────────────┐
           ▼                                                 ▼
[MINISTRIES: The Corporations]                    [REBELS: The Runners]
- Pool treasury credits to advance Agendas       - Infiltrate Ministry Concessions
- Enforce escalating authoritarian decrees       - Bypass Ministry "Ice" (Guards/Audits)
- Score Net Carbon Power for the Stag            - Execute "Runs" to Trash Agendas & Steal Truth
           │                                                 │
           └────────────────────────┬────────────────────────┘
                                    ▼
                [23:30 Grand Assembly & Climax]
      Agendas fully locked OR Resistance raids and exposes Cellar

5.0.1 The Central Decree Board (The 5 Agendas)
A large physical display in the main hall tracks the regime’s 5 grand corporate objectives: 1. Agenda 1: Ambient Dimming — Reduces venue lumens by 50%; activates Radiance blackout rules. 2. Agenda 2: Caloric Compression — Halves snack and bar dispensations; enforces algae ration rules. 3. Agenda 3: Sector Perimeter Lockdown — Severs corridor passage between zones without Service permits. 4. Agenda 4: Mandatory Heresy Purge — Authorizes Vigilance to execute public sidewalk audits. 5. Agenda 5: Total Silicon Consolidation — All citizen debt ledgers permanently locked; state power finalized.

Advancing an Agenda: Every 30 minutes, Ministries can invest treasury credits onto the Central Board. When an agenda receives 200 Credits in funding, it advances to the Staging Queue and is proclaimed over the PA system by Hanna.



5.0.2 Rebel Infiltration Runs (Netrunner Mechanics)
The Secret Resistance (headquartered in Thijs’s room, identified via the Ankle Stamp) operates as Runners attempting to disrupt the corporate machine.

The Run Loop:

Operatives receive a discrete Run Card from Thijs’s room targeting a specific Ministry station (e.g., reversing Flow’s meter, stealing Light’s backup drive, sabotaging Radiance’s dynamo).
Overcoming Ice (Defenses): The Runner must bypass station defenses (inquisitors, checkpoint guards, surveillance wardens) through stealth, distraction (e.g., triggering a wig duel nearby), or credit bribes.
Breaching & Trashing: Successful completion of a Run allows the Runner to:

Trash an Agenda: Remove 100 credits of funding from an active Corporate Agenda on the Central Board.
Extract a Truth Fragment: Collect physical evidence slips proving the Guardian Stag is powered by a salvaged corporate AI server in the cellar.





5.0.3 The Secret Legislative Council (Secret Hitler Dynamics)
Every 45 minutes, the Governor convenes the 10 Ministers for an Assembly. Two decree cards are drawn from the state deck. Hidden resistance moles within ministry ranks can use secret votes or procedural maneuvers to veto corporate decrees or slip through subversive resolutions (e.g., Decree of General Amnesty).




6 Climax & Endgame: The Revolution (23:30 – 00:15)
The live game outcome is dynamically determined by the economic struggle between Corporate Agendas and Rebel Runs:
23:30 ── State Assembly: Leader's Grand Spectacle & Ministry Showcases
23:45 ── Resistance Raid: Ankle-stamped rebels storm the podium
00:00 ── The Great Reveal: Cellar server node exposed; compliance proved a sham
00:15 ── Transition: The system falls; DJs take over for the dance party

The State Assembly (23:30): The loudspeaker orders all 10 Ministries to gather before the main stage. The supreme figurehead arrives amidst smoke and fanfare. Each ministry presents their chant, anthem, or synchronized formation.
The Resistance Raid (23:45): If the resistance has recruited over 50% of attendees with ankle stamps and trashed at least 3 Agendas, the moles signal the revolt. They storm the podium with black banners reading: “THE STAG IS SILICON. THE DEBT IS A LIE.”
The Big Reveal (00:00): Revolutionaries reveal the truth: the entire carbon credit ledger, the surveillance cameras, and the Guardian Stag calculations were never ecological—they were running on a salvaged corporate AI server node in the cellar! The regime was simply running compliance theater to preserve power.
Resolution (00:15): The ministries dissolve their rivalries, citizens tear out their passport debt pages, and the stage converts immediately into an open celebration dance floor with DJs running until 04:00+.




7 Guidelines for Activity Creators & Ministers

Always Word Positively: Punishments are “privileges”; starvation is “caloric purity”; forced chores are “joyful civic service.”
Keep the Barrier to Entry Low: Games must take under 3 minutes to learn and under 10 minutes to play.
Always Award Credit Stamps: Every completed activity must offer a tangible reward on the player’s physical passport booklet (+10 to +50 credits) and clipboard ledger.
Respect the Universal Safe-Word: If any player utters “OZONE”, pause immediately, drop character, and ensure they are supported.
